title: Hunts FH-020X: Bind placements to stops in the app and let a resident mark a stop as staff-confirmed
detail: No application code writes hunt_placements or hunt_mission_placements: a published Trail has no bound placement until someone inserts rows by hand, and publishRows always writes required_assurance signed_node. So the FH-020V switch is saved and published but cannot change a real claim yet: hunt_claim_apply holds a visit only for a signed scan against a staff-level mission whose binding carries evidence_policy.hold_for_review. Build the store command that creates a placement for a stop and binds it to the published version (venue Space included, evidence policy from stopEvidencePolicy), behind HUNTS_AUTHORING_ENABLED, and a Studio entity field that marks a stop as staff-confirmed so its mission publishes at staff assurance. Done when: publishing a Trail with a staff-confirmed stop that has the review switch on yields a binding with hold_for_review true, proved by a test, and a scan at that stop answers held. Requires: FH-020V, FH-015. Owner role: Web.
